Summary: Biblical leadership is shepherding, not lording: leading by serving, character, and example as Jesus did when He washed His disciples' feet. God raises leaders to equip His people, guard the truth, and care for the flock at cost to themselves. The measure of a leader is not platform or power but faithfulness and love for people.
KeyPassages: Joshua 1:8-9; Proverbs 11:14; Mark 10:42-45; John 13:14-15; 1 Timothy 3:1-7; Titus 1:7-9; 1 Peter 5:2-3
RelatedPeople: Moses; Joshua; David; Nehemiah; Jesus; Paul; Timothy
RelatedQuestions: What makes a good leader according to the Bible?; How should Christians respond to flawed leaders?
